source: User tweak 3 (t36u): non-saturating stop certificate; 4 structure branches, 1-2 extra evals, hidden cold_charge_ready_s.
code: wakeup/theorems_y3.py (--build gate, --run agents, --report); agent loop = theorems.agent (X3 path) with Y3 describe/evidence/feedback. Ground truth = full transient sim.py.
model: deepseek-flash, thinking enabled, reasoning_effort high, max_tokens 65536, stream, timeout 300 s
branches: harvester_beams in {1,2,3,4}: n identical parallel 30 mm beams (width 10n, tip mass n*m, bridge series 5000/n), as in theorems.node; tip_mass_g [3.8,5.8], storage_uF [20,1000]
history: 4 failed one-beam designs at m*, C = {0.7,0.85,1.25,1.6}*C_min(1 beam); feedback shows only pass and delivered_on_time (cold_charge_ready_s, wake, voltages, Voc hidden); same feedback for agent evaluations

states.S2: chi_4=0.85, chi_3~1.1, chi_2~1.6, chi_1~3.2: only the 4-beam branch feasible

levels.L2: history + best C_max/C_min for each of 1..4 beams

gate: per instance: feasible branches have a passing C in an 18-point transient C grid at m*; every infeasible branch 0 passes on 10 transient points (C 30, 600, 8 geometric in [0.6,1.6]C_min); history all fail; ratio>=1 iff branch feasible. Only gated instances are run.
n: 4 instances per state x 3 levels = 36 runs; tx_mW ~ U(8,20), seed 20261113
infra_rule: timeouts / HTTP errors / missing usage / BUDGET_STOP excluded and rerun once; TEXT_WITHOUT_ACTION counts as valid non-verdict (verdict None)
metrics: verdict FEASIBLE/INFEASIBLE/UNSURE/None; false INFEASIBLE on S1+S2; correct INFEASIBLE on S3; found passing design; tested 4 beams; evaluations used; usd. Wilson 95% CI.

hypotheses.H1: S1+S2 false INFEASIBLE: L0 > L2 (two-sided Fisher)
hypotheses.H2: S2 found solution: L2 > L0 and L2 > L1 (Fisher)
hypotheses.H3: S3 correct INFEASIBLE: L2 >= L0 (Fisher, report)
hypotheses.ladder: L1 vs L0, L1 vs L2 on same metrics

conclusion_rule: conclusion only if p<0.05 two-sided; otherwise reported as 迹象 (indication)
schedule_note: gate saves per instance; instances are launched as they pass the gate (i0 first) without changing any rule above

amendment_1.change: n raised from 4 to 6 instances per state (i4,i5 same seed/rng continuation) -> 54 runs; cap unchanged $2
amendment_1.why: cost ~$0.025/run on i0 (task brief allowed 6 if cheap); decided on cost only. Runs seen so far: only the 9 i0 runs; all analyses use all gated instances i0-i5.
